refusal.message: baseline 'vibe-ic-pnr-only-searched' does not declare `tuned_by_this_project: false`. A baseline we tune is an oracle we wrote, and a favourable number measured against it says nothing about silicon.

_refiled_note: This is ppa_head_to_head_check's refusal of the document now filed at ppa-crosslayer/records/ablations/ablation_pnr_only_vs_crosslayer.json as vibeic.ppa.ablation.v1. It is KEPT because it is the evidence that the re-filing is a correction and not a convenience: the gate refused the document, the refusal was right, and the numbers did not change. A re-filing whose causing refusal has been deleted is indistinguishable from a record that was always this kind.
